column1: # Traditional forms that OpenCC gets wrong for medical terms, corrected after the conversion.
# One per line: simplified phrase<TAB>its traditional form as Taiwan writes it (the same number of characters).
# Wherever the phrase occurs in a headword (or an alternate key), the characters in which this form differs
# from what OpenCC writes for the phrase replace OpenCC's, in the Taiwan form and in the Hong Kong and OpenCC
# spellings alike; the other characters of the phrase keep each standard's own form (衛 / 衞). So a corrected
# character must be one all three standards write the same way. A phrase has to be long enough to contain
# what misleads OpenCC: a line that OpenCC already converts as stated is refused when the table is loaded.
# This is for words read as another word. It is not for a character two standards write differently.
# `python -m medical_yomitan golden` keeps the important ones checked.
# -- 症 (zhèng, a disease) is not 癥 (zhēng, a lump in the abdomen): OpenCC reads 血症 as the 中医 term 血癥
# -- Transliterated names and acupuncture points keep the character: 里 is not 裡, 范 not 範, 朴 not 樸, 托 not 託
# -- 面 (a surface) is not 麵 (flour); 揉面感 and 臭米面 are flour and stay 麵
# -- 钟 (a bell, a clock) is 鐘; 鍾 is the one of 钟情
# -- 发 (to come out, to develop) is 發; OpenCC sees the words 发型, 生发, 染发, 齿发, 肤发
# -- 后 (behind) is 後; 后 is a queen
# -- 干 (dry) is 乾; 幹 is a trunk or a stem
# -- 脏 (an organ) is 臟; 髒 is dirty
# -- 咽 (the pharynx) stays 咽; 嚥 is to swallow, as in 吞嚥
# -- 酸 (an acid) stays 酸; 痠 is an ache, as in 痠痛
# -- Other words read as another word
